---
title: "Shiny app"
description: "One workspace for data managers and statisticians."
---

```r
library(REDCapCDMSTAT)
run_app()            # the saved REDCap connection, or the demo if none
run_app(nx)          # an engine you already opened
```

The app uses the same engine and ledger as the R package. A query raised in
the app shows up in `nx$queries()`, and the script logged by your clicks
replays in R. Each browser session has its own engine, so choosing a data
cut affects only that user. Changes made through the API or REDCap's Data
Entry Trigger appear within three seconds.

## Overview

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-overview.png" class="screenshot" alt="Overview tab">

Records, open queries, rule violations and the last sync, followed by queries
by status and source, dictionary drift history and sync history.

## Data quality

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-data-quality.png" class="screenshot" alt="Data quality tab">

The current rule violations from the live dictionary and your custom rules.
**Raise queries for new issues** creates queries; fixed issues auto-resolve.
You can add custom rules in REDCap logic from the sidebar.

## Queries

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-queries.png" class="screenshot" alt="Queries tab">

The query ledger with filters. Select a query to see its audit trail, move
it to another status (a reason is required) or comment. **Enable DRW
write-back** and **Sync with REDCap DRW** connect it to REDCap's Data
Resolution Workflow.

## Explore: point, click, query

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-explore.png" class="screenshot" alt="Explore tab">

A scatter of any two numeric fields, with outliers on Y flagged by robust z
or Tukey IQR per visit. Clicking a point opens a pre-filled query for that
record, visit and field, which lands in the same ledger the data managers
work from.

## Wrangle

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-wrangle.png" class="screenshot" alt="Wrangle tab">

Toggle long or wide by event, and drop, collapse or isolate repeating forms.
The variable list updates immediately; download the CSV.

## Statistics

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-table1.png" class="screenshot" alt="Table 1">

Table 1 by any categorical field and event, with the rationale for each test.

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-trends.png" class="screenshot" alt="Longitudinal trends">

Mean and 95% CI of any field by visit and arm.

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-model.png" class="screenshot" alt="Model builder with a mixed model">

The model builder fits linear, logistic, Cox and mixed models. Here a mixed
model for repeated systolic BP recovers the simulated drug effect at week 24.

## Data cuts and script

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-cuts.png" class="screenshot" alt="Data cuts">

Freeze the current data, sign a cut off, and choose a cut to analyse.

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-script.png" class="screenshot" alt="Script">

The reproducible R script of the session's analysis steps.

## CDMS menu

| Tab | What it does |
|---|---|
| Randomization | Generate the concealed stratified schedule; randomise subjects; see balance and the allocation log |
| SDV | Apply the risk-based plan; tick units and mark them verified |
| Locks & e-signatures | Lock or unlock records; sign records (re-typing your user name) |
| Medical coding | Auto-code a verbatim field; approve suggestions; load your dictionary |
| Deviations | Detect out-of-window visits; log and close deviations |
| Site metrics | Per-site queries, SDV progress and deviations; enrolment curves |
| CDISC export | SDTM DM, VS, LB, AE, SV, DS previews; download SDTM, define.xml and ODM as a zip |
| Activity trail | Every CDMS action, append-only |

## Connection

<img src="../reference/figures/screenshots/shiny-connection.png" class="screenshot" alt="Connection tab">

Test a REDCap URL and token (read-only), then save and connect. See
[Connect your REDCap project](connect-redcap.html).

## Portfolio dashboard

```r
run_portfolio(c(trial_a = "C:/data/trial_a", trial_b = "C:/data/trial_b"))
```

A separate app that summarises several study folders side by side: records,
randomised subjects, open queries and the oldest open query, rule violations,
SDV progress, deviations and locks. It also shows site metrics across all
studies.
